name: Harrow & Finch Ventilated Patrol Cap
description:
A structured patrol cap with micro-ventilation channels woven into the crown, designed for long-duration outdoor wear in GLMZ's variable climate. The brim contains a rigid insert for shape retention and the inner band uses moisture-wicking synth-fabric. No electronics, no smart-fabric — just well-made headwear.

Standard issue for several private security firms and popular with anyone who spends extended hours on foot in sun or rain. The cap comes in neutral tones — slate, sand, olive — and resists both UV degradation and the kind of grime that accumulates in lower-tier streets.
what_it_says: You spend your days outside and you picked gear that handles it without complaint.
story_hooks: A security contractor's patrol cap is found on a rooftop overlooking a Spire executive's apartment — positioned as though someone spent hours watching from that spot.

physical_description.visual_profile: A crisp, structured patrol cap with a pronounced stiff brim and slightly rounded crown. Clean lines and utilitarian silhouette evoke military-adjacent professionalism without tactical aggression. Sits squarely on the head with subtle forward pitch.
physical_description.fit: True to size, sits level on the crown with a secure but comfortable band. Brim depth ~2.5 inches, provides substantial sun/rain coverage without obstructing peripheral vision. Adjustable rear closure allows for augmentation accommodation (neural jacks, subcutaneous ports).
physical_description.primary_material: High-grade synth-cotton blend with woven micro-ventilation channels throughout the crown. Inner moisture-wicking synth-fabric band. Brim reinforced with rigid composite insert (non-magnetic, non-conductive).
physical_description.texture: Smooth, tightly-woven exterior with subtle channeled pattern visible on the crown. Soft matte finish resists glare. Interior band is soft, slightly brushed texture. Brim edge is cleanly finished with minimal fraying.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in slate grey, sand beige, or olive drab. Solid, no patterns. Subtle Harrow & Finch embroidered logo on the front panel in matching thread.
physical_description.closures: Adjustable rear closure with friction-fit synthetic strap (no metal hardware to corrode in GLMZ humidity). Modern buckle-free design.
distinctive_features: Micro-ventilation channels woven into crown for extended wear comfort
Rigid brim insert maintains shape under rain/moisture
Moisture-wicking inner band prevents sweat accumulation
Designed to sit over augmentation hardware without pressure points
Minimal seams to reduce water infiltration
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 transitional: affordable quality without luxury pricing, standard issue for private security and working professionals
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by patrol officers, security contractors, outdoor maintenance workers, street hustlers with steady income, anyone prioritizing function over fashion. Signals reliability and outdoor competence. Not uncommon in mid-tier corpo security uniforms.
physical_description.condition_typical: Breaks in cleanly with wear; develops subtle creasing along the crown and slight patina on the brim from sun exposure. Resists staining and maintains structural integrity through heavy use. Well-maintained examples look nearly new after 2+ years.
